name: 02-capabilities
teaches: One program, two apps: with no config all three calls are denied by the gate, and under a config that wires fs to a directory the same three answer ok, error from the connector, and denied by the caps ceiling.
cmd: echo '$ drt run app.dlua'; drt run app.dlua; echo; echo '$ drt run --config with-fs.json'; drt run --config with-fs.json
